<thought>Search the template catalog for reactions that form a sulfonamide (the forward reaction). This should retrieve the template whose retrosynthetic application yields the amine and sulfonyl‑chloride precursors observed earlier.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)N)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
